{{Quote|The fighting continues in the Minos Cluster, but we received dispatches last week indicating that the Seswenna sector had been lost.|Jedi Knight Gnost-Dural|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
In [[3671 BBY]], during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] was '''attacked and seized''' by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces. This [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] operation finalized the Imperial conquest of the Outer Rim and allowed for the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] to initiate plans for an attack on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], specifically the Republic-allied [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|When the Emperor planned the Republic's destruction, he did not foresee the need for alliances. The Sith would sweep through the galaxy, systematically exterminating their age-old Jedi enemies and dismantling the proud Republic.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 5" />}}
When the once-decimated [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] returned to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and initiated the [[Great Galactic War]], it focused its operations in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]&mdash;a region weak in both [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] loyalty and defense priority. The [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] was highly successful in his campaigns in the region and quickly claimed victory in the [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]], the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]], the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], and the entirety of the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]], among other territories.<ref name="Timeline 6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref> The Empire initiated a [[Blockade of the Rimma Trade Route|blockade]] of the Rimma Trade Route in that first year of the war, but their fleet, stationed in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]], was defeated by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[3680 BBY|one year later]].<ref name="JoMGD" />

==The seizure==
{{Quote|After the Sith offensive seized the Seswenna sector of the Outer Rim, the Imperial armada tuned its sights closer to the Core. The Mid Rim.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|audio=TheMidRim-Timeline5.flac|<ref name="Timeline 5" />}}
While Republic leaders [[Senate emergency defense session|remained incapable]] of deciding a proper response to the Empire's attacks,<ref name="Timeline 6" /> the Empire returned to the Seswenna sector in [[3671 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> and retook the region, thereby finalizing the Imperial conquest of the Outer Rim.<ref name="Timeline 5" /> Among the casualties of the battle was Republic [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Joron Tal'vor]], the husband of [[Republic Army]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Elin Garza]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Believing the Republic was still recovering from its heavy losses, Imperial forces charged into Bothan Space, where they were caught off guard by the full force of the Republic fleet.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|audio=CaughOffGuard-Timeline5.flac|<ref name="Timeline 5" />}}
The capture of the Seswenna [[Sector/Legends|sector]] marked a turning point in the war. Confident that the Outer Rim was no longer in need of the undivided attention of his [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]], the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] began plans for an incursion into the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]&mdash;one step closer to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] of the Galactic Republic.<ref name="Timeline 5" /> Less than a week after the victory in the Seswenna sector, the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Armada]] sent a strike [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to [[First Battle of Bothawui|attempt a seizure]] of the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. The attack was predicted by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Greik]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and so met with failure,<ref name="JoMGD" /> but the Emperor would attempt [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|another attack]] shortly thereafter.<ref name="Timeline 5" /> Sometime after the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], which ended the war,<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] made mention of the capture of the Seswenna sector in a [[Holodocumentary|holorecord]] for the [[Jedi Archives (Tython)|Jedi Archives]].<ref name="Timeline 5" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Empire's seizure of the Seswenna sector was first mentioned in the fifth installment of the ''[[Galactic Timeline]]'', entitled [[Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui|''The Battle of Bothawui'']]. The ''Galactic Timeline'' is an online promotional feature for the [[LucasArts]] / [[BioWare]] [[2012]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The installments are available through [[The Holonet]] section of the official [http://swtor.com ''Old Republic'' Web site].
